rooms.description: Reality stutters here — the edges of the room double and flicker out of sync with themselves.
Fragments of a dozen different moments overlap in this hallway, none of them quite solid.
A doorway hangs caught mid-collapse, forever falling — and something ancient watches from just beyond it.
Old broadcasts loop endlessly here, voices reciting news from eras that never happened.
A market that exists in three timelines at once; the goods are somehow all still fresh.
The walls here remember being built, and unbuilt, over and over, and still haven't decided.
A mirror-still pool reflects a sky that hasn't existed yet.
